title: Record a voice message
summary: Records a voice message in the composer, with pause and resume, then a preview where the user listens and checks the transcript the phone made. Send puts the transcript in the caption of the voice event (ADR 0023).

phase.description: recording: bipe_app_voice_recording with the live waveform and time. paused: the time stops, bipe_app_voice_resume. preview: play, the transcript field, delete and send. sending: the event goes to the send queue.

duration.description: Recorded length in milliseconds, for bipe_app_voice_duration.

waveform.description: The waveform for the bubble, about 100 samples.

transcript.description: off: no speech permission or no on-device model: no field. working: bipe_voice_transcribing. ready: the editable text. unavailable: bipe_voice_transcript_unavailable.

transcriptText.description: The text the user sends. Starts as the phone's transcript; the user can correct or clear it.

microphoneDenied.description: true: bipe_microphone_permission_body with a button to the app's settings, and no recording.

start.effect: Asks for the microphone the first time. Starts recording to a local Ogg Opus file, mono. phase recording.

resume.effect: paused only: records on into the same file. phase recording.

stop.effect: Ends the recording. Shorter than 1 second: bipe_app_voice_too_short and back to the composer. Else phase preview, and the phone starts the transcript on the device.

play.effect: preview only: plays or pauses the recording.

delete.effect: Drops the file and the transcript. Back to the composer.

send.effect: Timeline.sendAttachment with AttachmentKind voice (AudioInfo with duration, the waveform) and UploadParameters with caption transcriptText when transcript is ready and the text is not blank. A transcript still working is dropped: the user never waits for it (ADR 0023). A failure shows bipe_app_voice_failed on the item in the timeline.

notes: Transcript (ADR 0023): the sender's phone transcribes, on the device only. No server fallback, ever. No permission or no on-device model for the language: the message goes without a transcript. Language: the first of the phone's preferred languages that the phone transcribes offline, then pt-BR; no language detection (bipe/docs/audio.md).
The caption of a voice event is the transcript. Bipe offers no other caption on voice messages, so readers can trust a caption on a voice message to be the sender's transcript.

Bipe logic: VoiceTranscriber.transcribe and VoiceTranscriptDraft (BipeKit VoiceTranscriber.swift, Apple Speech with on-device recognition); BipeVoiceTranscriber.kt (libraries/bipe voice). Android needs an on-device recogniser; without one the transcript stays off.

Wire format: m.audio with the voice flag (MSC3245) and Ogg Opus, which every Matrix client plays (bipe/docs/audio.md). The app sets the bitrate itself; a lower bitrate saves data on Brazilian carriers.
Maximum length: Bipe has not decided one. Open point for the build lane to raise with MZ.
The reader side (the bubble, three lines of transcript, playback speed) and the scam check on transcripts belong to the timeline media spec (bipe-chat/bipe#561).
